title: yakuptv-texture
description: A custom and minimalist resource pack that changes the Minecraft splash screen, totem image, totem explosion sound, and End portal! Current Status: The game's splash screen is not working.
body:
[Yakup Tv Pack] - Minecraft Visual & Audio Overhaul
Designed to customize your Minecraft experience, this resource pack makes some of the game's core visuals and sounds much cooler and more modern! It both elevates the most crucial in-game moments (like the totem pop) and beautifies the user interface.
✨ Features
🖥️ Custom Loading Screen: The classic, boring loading screen that appears when the game boots up has been completely revamped! A stylish, modern intro screen now welcomes you.
👁️ Revamped Totem & Pop Sound: The texture of the Totem of Undying has been completely redesigned. On top of that, the sound effect when the totem pops has been replaced with a much more satisfying and custom sound!
🌌 Cosmic End Portal: The texture of the portal gateway that leads to the End dimension has been modified. Now, when looking into the portal, you will see a much deeper and more striking visual experience.
🛠️ Installation
Copy the downloaded .zip file.
Launch Minecraft, then navigate to Options > Resource Packs > Open Pack Folder.
Paste the .zip file into the folder that opens, and activate it from inside the game!
